description: Found by Elixir Parity reviewing fz-mue.29 (2026-11-20); filed under the user's standing direction to put Elixir parity gaps on fz-mue. `struct!(KeyError, [{:__struct__, Other}, ...])`: Elixir raises ArgumentError when struct!/2 is given a __struct__ pair naming another module. fz's lib/kernel.fz skips the pair silently (put_declared_field!({:__struct__, _}, base)) and returns the struct. Done: the same call raises ArgumentError with Elixir's message on interp, run and build, pinned by an oracle fixture. Follows fz-3sy.21. Owner: Elixir Parity.
title: struct!/2 given a different __struct__ raises ArgumentError, as in Elixir
